Package index

Simplex chart

Shared by both generative models (R/02_00_ilr_chart.R): simplex repair, the Helmert basis and the isometric log-ratio (ILR) chart with its first and second derivatives.

repair_simplex()
Repair a numeric vector onto the unit simplex
helmert_basis()
Helmert contrast matrix for isometric log-ratio coordinates
isometric_logistic() isometric_log_ratio()
Isometric logistic transform (ILR coordinates to the simplex)
jacobian_isometric_logistic()
Jacobian of the isometric logistic map
hessian_isometric_logistic()
Hessian tensor of the isometric logistic map

Population references: Gaussian convolution

Bulk covariance (_j p_j^2_j) (article Section “Population-level references”).

Optimisation

Log-likelihood, score and Hessian, the solver family (Newton–Raphson by default, with the PORT trust region of stats::nlminb), starting values and multistarts (R/02_02_population_decovart_estimate_ratios.R, R/02_03_population_decovart_fit.R).

fit_decovart() print(<decovart_fit>) summary(<decovart_fit>) print(<summary.decovart_fit>) coef(<decovart_fit>) fitted(<decovart_fit>) residuals(<decovart_fit>) vcov(<decovart_fit>) nobs(<decovart_fit>) confint(<decovart_fit>) plot(<decovart_fit>)
Fit the DeCovarT Gaussian-convolution model
deconvolute_ratios_cibersort() deconvolute_ratios_rlm() deconvolute_ratios_nnls() deconvolute_ratios_deconrnaseq() deconvolute_ratios_Marquardt_Levenberg() deconvolute_ratios_simulated_annealing() deconvolute_ratios_L_BFGS_B() deconvolute_ratios_Newton_Raphson() deconvolute_ratios_gradient_descent()
DeCovarT MLE of cellular proportions for one bulk sample
starting_simplex()
Open-simplex start for ILR solvers
multistart_decovart()
Refit DeCovarT from several random starts to probe multimodality
loglik_multivariate()
Unconstrained DeCovarT log-likelihood
gradient_loglik_unconstrained()
Gradient \(\nabla_{\boldsymbol{p}}\ell\) of the unconstrained log-likelihood
hessian_loglik_unconstrained()
Hessian \(\mathbf{H}\) of the unconstrained log-likelihood
gradient_loglik_constrained()
Constrained gradient via the chain rule
hessian_loglik_constrained()
Constrained Hessian of \(\ell\circ\boldsymbol{\psi}\)

Inference

Confidence intervals and tests (R/03_01 to R/03_03): the confint_decovart() menu (ILR back-transformation by default, Wald, Firth, profile likelihood, parametric and reference bootstraps), restricted fits on simplex faces and chi-bar-square tests.

confint_decovart()
Choose a confidence interval for a pooled DeCovarT composition
confint_ilr_backtransform()
Confidence intervals by mapping a Wald region through the ILR chart
expected_fisher_unconstrained()
Expected Fisher information of unconstrained \(\boldsymbol{p}\)
vcov_ilr_delta()
Cramer–Rao / ILR delta-method covariance of \(\hat{\boldsymbol{p}}\)
fit_firth_decovart()
Firth-penalised DeCovarT fit
confint_profile_decovart()
Profile-likelihood confidence intervals for cellular ratios
restricted_mle_decovart()
Maximum likelihood on the closed simplex, optionally on a face
lrt_decovart()
Likelihood-ratio test for cellular ratios
chi_bar_square_pvalue()
Chi-bar-square tail probability for boundary likelihood-ratio tests
boundary_diagnostics()
Boundary and stationarity diagnostics for one DeCovarT fit
bootstrap_decovart()
Parametric bootstrap for DeCovarT proportions and boundary tests
reference_bootstrap_decovart()
Reference-based bootstrap for signature and composition uncertainty
equivariance_check_decovart()
Permutation-equivariance check for a labelled reference

Single-cell references: mixture of independent cells

Bulk covariance (j p_j{W,j}) with a mean scale (c) and a variance scale () (article Section “Single-cell references”).

Optimisation

Free-scale least-squares start, closed-form scales, and Newton–Raphson on the profile log-likelihood (R/02_02_single_cell_decovart_estimate_ratios.R).

deconvolute_single_cell()
Single-cell deconvolution of one bulk sample
single_cell_nuisance_scales()
Stage-i scales for one single-cell bulk sample
loglik_single_cell()
Log-likelihood of one single-cell bulk sample
profile_loglik_single_cell_ilr() gradient_profile_loglik_single_cell_ilr() hessian_profile_loglik_single_cell_ilr()
Profile log-likelihood of one single-cell bulk sample in ILR coordinates

Inference

The confint_single_cell() menu, with intervals for the composition and for the two scales (R/03_04_single_cell_inference.R).

confint_single_cell()
Confidence intervals for one single-cell bulk sample
vcov_single_cell()
Observed information of one single-cell fit
fit_firth_single_cell()
Firth fit of one single-cell bulk sample
confint_profile_single_cell()
Profile-likelihood intervals for one single-cell bulk sample
restricted_mle_single_cell()
Maximum likelihood on a face of the single-cell model
lrt_single_cell()
Likelihood-ratio test for one single-cell composition
bootstrap_single_cell()
Parametric bootstrap for one single-cell bulk sample
reference_bootstrap_single_cell()
Reference bootstrap for the single-cell mixture

Generative models

Population references

Mean signatures with prescribed pairwise cosines, graph-constrained cell-type covariances, and bulk samples drawn from the Gaussian convolution (R/01_01_population_toy_simulation.R, R/01_02_generate_synthetic_networks.R).

generate_mean_signature_matrix()
Generate mean profiles from a target Gram matrix
simulate_hierarchical_grn_moments()
Simulate GRN first- and second-order moments
simulate_bulk_mixture()
Simulate bulk mixtures from a multivariate Gaussian convolution

Single-cell references

Cell-size conventions, the four-scenario design, and bulk samples drawn as sums of multinomial counts of cells (R/01_01_single_cell_toy_simulation.R, R/01_02_single_cell_generate_synthetic_networks.R).

simulate_bulk_from_cells()
Simulate a bulk sample as a sum of single cells
rescale_single_cell_moments()
Cell-size conventions for a single-cell reference
single_cell_scenario_design()
Four single-cell simulation scenarios

Reference panels

Independent purified profiles or cells per individual, for benchmark methods that estimate the reference moments themselves (R/01_06_reference_replicates.R).

simulate_reference_replicates()
Simulate an independent reference panel

Benchmark

Run

Fit every algorithm to every bulk sample, over a scenario grid (R/04_01_run_benchmark.R, R/04_02_run_simulation_benchmark.R).

deconvolute_ratios()
Parallel deconvolution of a bulk expression matrix
run_simulation_benchmark()
Simulate bulk mixtures and benchmark deconvolution algorithms
describe_simulation_scenario()
Describe a Gaussian-convolution simulation scenario

Metrics

Global and per-cell-type performance scores, Monte Carlo coverage (R/04_03, R/04_04), and scenario descriptors: entropy of the composition, overlap and divergences between cell-type distributions (R/01_03 to R/01_05).

compute_benchmark_metrics()
Compute deconvolution benchmark metrics
population_likelihood() single_cell_likelihood()
Likelihood objects for the benchmark
kkt_residual()
Simplex KKT / projected-score residual
coverage_mc_interval()
Monte Carlo interval for an empirical coverage probability
compute_shannon_entropy()
Normalised Shannon entropy of a discrete distribution
composition_from_entropy()
One-dominant composition with a target normalised Shannon entropy
compute_average_overlap()
Average pairwise overlap of a Gaussian mixture
overlap_gaussian_mc()
MixSim-style pairwise overlap via stratified Sobol Monte Carlo
compute_average_riemannian()
Mean pairwise AIRM distance of component covariances
compute_average_jeffreys()
Average pairwise Jeffreys divergence of a Gaussian mixture
hellinger_gaussian()
Hellinger distance between two multivariate Gaussians
scale_covariance_array()
Scale component covariances, keeping precision zeros
scale_covariances_to_overlap()
Calibrate a global covariance scale to a target MixSim BarOmega

Visualisation

Pivot Monte Carlo proportion estimates to a long table
plot_mc_raincloud()
Horizontal raincloud of Monte Carlo proportion estimates
plot_mc_forest()
Forest plot of ADEMP Monte Carlo summaries
plot_mc_metric_dots()
Faceted dot plot of several ADEMP metrics
algorithm_similarity()
Algorithm-similarity correlation from a Monte Carlo benchmark
plot_algorithm_similarity()
Tile heatmap of algorithm-similarity correlations
theme_decovart_facets()
Faceted ggplot2 theme (black strips, panel border)
